content_feed.headline: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Declares 2nd Interim Dividend of Re. 1 Per Share
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company declared a 2nd interim dividend and provided a material update on its capacity expansion project timelines.
content_feed.telegram_post: 💵 #DIVIDEND | Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited (NSE: BEPL) Bhansali Engineering Polymers Declares 2nd Interim Dividend of Re. 1 Per Share ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Dividend Amount: Re. 1/- per equity share (100% on face value of Re. 1/-) - Record Date: Saturday, October 24, 2026 - Payment Date: On or before November 17, 2026 - Expansion Update: ABS production capacity expansion (75,000 TPA to 100,000 TPA, Rs. 200 Cr cost) revised to March 2027 due to global supply chain delays. 📌 What happened: ↳ The board approved the un-audited financial results and declared the 2nd interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27.
